k:HH.Ai.Concierge.Tips: Here is what I see, most common first:
k:HH.Ai.Concierge.Title: Ask the concierge
k:HH.Ai.Consent.Budget: The AI budget is shared by all players over 24 hours. When it is used up, the AI rests and the game uses its own texts.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.D.Claim: Claim letters: the policy, the pawn's name, the incident, the decision and the amount that the game already decided, and what you wrote in the claim form (600 letters at most).
k:HH.Ai.Consent.D.Concierge: Concierge: your question (300 letters at most) and up to 12 short facts, such as renown, number of guests and beds, and the problems the game found.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.D.Headline: Market headlines: the kind of market event, the name of the asset and the size of the move. At most 8 events per request.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.D.Ottoline: Ask Ottoline: your question (500 letters at most) and a snapshot of the books: balance, savings, up to 10 loans, investments, policies and recent bookings, as numbers and short labels.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.D.Review: Guest reviews: the guest's first name, the stars the game gave, a few reason words (for example the way they left) and the kinds of venue they spent money in.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.Done: AI texts are on. The game checks the relay now.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.Intro: Hearth & Harbor can let an AI write some flavour texts: Clerk Ottoline's chat answers, market headlines, guest reviews, insurance claim letters and the concierge's tips. The game plays exactly the same without it, and it always has its own texts ready for when the AI is away.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.NotSent: What is NOT sent: your Steam name or id, file paths, the name of your save or colony, your other mods, or anything that looks like a key.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.Sent: What is sent: game text for the request, for example pawn names (up to 64 letters), amounts, the text you type into the chat, the claim form or the concierge box, and counts such as guests or beds.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.Stored: What is stored: the relay keeps only counters (how many tokens, what it cost, how long it took, error codes). It does not keep what you wrote or what the AI answered. Like any web server, the host of the relay may briefly hold your IP address in its technical connection logs.
k:HH.Ai.Consent.Title: AI texts (optional)
k:HH.Ai.Consent.Where: Where it goes: to a small relay server run by the author of this mod (hh-relay.jberger.de), and from there through OpenRouter to Anthropic's Claude models, using only providers that keep no data (zero data retention).
k:HH.Ai.Consent.Withdraw: You can withdraw at any time: Mod settings, Hearth & Harbor, AI flavour, Forget my consent.
k:HH.Ai.Notice.Title: Hearth & Harbor: a note about the AI texts
k:HH.Ai.Panel.ConsentNone: You have not agreed yet. Nothing is sent.
k:HH.Ai.Panel.ForgetConfirm: Forget your consent and switch the AI module off? Nothing is sent from then on. You can agree again at any time.
k:HH.Ai.Panel.Relay: Relay: shared budget used {0} % of the last 24 hours. This session: {1} sent, {2} ok, {3} failed, {4} own texts used.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.1.0: One star, and only because the form has no zero.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.1.1: I asked for a quiet night and got a lesson in patience.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.1.2: Never again, though the door was lovely on the way out.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.1.3: I have stayed in worse. I cannot remember where.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.2.0: It was fine if you like waiting. I do not.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.2.2: The staff tried. The building did not help.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.2.3: Two stars: one for the effort, one for the door.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.3.0: A room, a roof and a reasonably warm welcome.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.3.1: Nothing to complain about and nothing to write home about, so here I am.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.3.2: Decent. I would come back if the road happened to bring me.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.3.3: Three stars. The middle of the road is a fine place to stand.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.4.0: Good food, kind people, a bed that behaved itself.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.4.1: I slept well and paid fairly. That is rarer than it sounds.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.4.2: Pleasant and well run. I will tell my caravan.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.4.3: Four stars. Something was missing and I forgot what, which says plenty.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.5.0: Best stay of the season. The staff remembered my name and my order.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.5.1: I came for a night and almost forgot to leave.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.5.2: Warm, clean, funny. Five stars and a handshake.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.5.3: I would live here if they let me, and they might not.
k:HH.Ai.Review.Label: Guest review: {0}
k:HH.Ai.State.NoConsent: AI texts are not set up
k:HH.Ai.State.NoConsent.Tip: Nothing is sent anywhere until you agree. The game uses its own texts.
k:HH.Ai.State.Off.Tip: Switch the module on in the Hearth & Harbor settings.
k:HH.Ai.State.Offline.Tip: The relay could not be reached. The game uses its own texts and tries again later.
k:HH.Ai.State.Online.Tip: The relay answers. Texts written by the AI are marked.
k:HH.Ai.State.Paused: AI paused for a few minutes
k:HH.Ai.State.Paused.Tip: Several requests failed in a row. The game uses its own texts for ten minutes.
k:HH.Ai.State.Resting.Tip: The shared daily budget of the relay is used up. The game uses its own texts until it recovers.
k:HH.Ai.State.Unavailable.Tip: The relay is switched off or not ready. The game uses its own texts.
k:HH.Bank.Card.InterestTip: The account interest is a share ({0}) of the market return, times this bank's own factor ({1}). Investments pay more.
k:HH.Bank.Card.Numbers: Interest {0} a year  ·  deposit fee {1} %  ·  withdrawal {2} %  ·  account fee {3} per quadrum
k:HH.Bank.Header.TierTip: Net worth = account + deposits in transit + silver at home + investments (at market value) − debts: {0} silver. The tier only changes after a new value has held for a whole day. It sets the colony mood from this bank (setting: bank.moodOn).
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.BalanceTip:
Exact: {0} silver.
The account is a savings account: it pays {1} % of the market's surplus (M − 1) a year, times {2} for this bank. With M = {3} that is {4} % a year ({5} % a day). Investing pays more, and costs risk.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.DirectTip: Tills of your businesses are emptied into the account at midnight, minus {0} %. Change it in the mod settings (Bank > Account).
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.InvestedTip: Stocks, funds, crypto and NFTs at today's market value: {0}. Patience bonds at their current value: {1}. Money staked in Omen contracts and faction projects (at cost): {2}.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.MaxTip: All the silver of the colony in storage and at the trade beacon. There is no upper limit.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.MaxTipWd: Everything the account can pay out here (after fees).
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.NetTip:
Account {0} + in transit {1} + silver at home {2} + investments at market value {3} − debts {4} = {5}.
Sets your wealth tier. Credit limits count only {6} % of the investments (setting bank.loanPortfolioShare).
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.PercentWd: {0} % of what the account can pay out ({1} of {2})
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.RateTip:
What the account earns per game year (60 days), on average. Compare with the products in the Invest tab:
{0}
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.TradeTip: Silver you get from traders and trade ships goes into the account right after the deal, at the same fee as direct deposit, instead of lying on the floor as coins. Needs direct deposit. Off by default, so you can still pay the next trader in cash. Caravans are not affected. Change it in the mod settings (Bank > Account).
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.TransitTip: Silver on its way: deposits not credited yet (deposit delay without a branch or ATM) and withdrawals still in a drop pod. It counts towards your net worth.
k:HH.Bank.Open.DirectState: Till money goes straight to the bank at midnight: {0}
k:HH.Bank.Open.DirectTip: Takings of your shops, inn and casino go into the account instead of lying around as silver. This is a term of the bank: change it in the mod settings (Bank > Account, bank.directDeposit).
k:HH.Bank.Quip.Invest: I see you have investments. I will pretend I am not jealous of a number.
k:HH.Bank.Reason.NoSilverAtAll: There is no silver in storage or at the trade beacon.
k:HH.Bank.Reason.NothingToWithdraw: The account has nothing to pay out here right now.
k:HH.Bank.Scen.LoanTip: 0 = no loan. A loan is paid out into the account and repaid in instalments like any other loan.
k:HH.Bank.Scen.Summary: Starts with an account at {0} holding {1} silver.
k:HH.Bank.Terms.AccountYearTip: Account multiple per year = 1 + share × bank factor × (M − 1) = 1 + {0} × {1} × ({2} − 1) = {3}, never below {4} or above {5}, and never above the savings product Mattress Plus ({6}).
k:HH.Bank.Terms.AnchorsHead: Index M per year  /  your account a year  /  highest collection stage
k:HH.Bank.Terms.Compare: Where money earns more (per game year, on average)
k:HH.Bank.Terms.CompareAccountTip: The account is safe and pays little. Mattress Plus, the bond and everything below it carry more risk or lock your money and pay more on average; the account itself never pays more than Mattress Plus.
k:HH.Bank.Terms.CompareTip: Long-run average of this product at the current profitability. Prices swing; a single year can be far above or below.
